mechanism: C2-KBEST-STABILITY over complete N1-valid occupied-conflict actions

c0_identity.unit: one complete N1-valid occupied-conflict graph action
c0_identity.component: transitive closure of actions sharing any owned source, destination, incumbent edge, challenger edge, or no-op endpoint
c0_identity.feasible_assignment: a subset of component actions with pairwise-disjoint N1 ownership whose deterministic N1 batch compiles; the empty subset is always the explicit no-op
c0_identity.edge_evidence: the authenticated 49th feature: normalized frozen Trackastra challenger association minus incumbent association for the exact conflict row
c0_identity.action_cost: negative sum of the action's authenticated Trackastra challenger-minus-incumbent margins
c0_identity.map: minimum total float64 action cost over feasible assignments
c0_identity.tie_break: total_cost, then lexicographically sorted tuple of canonical N1 action SHA-256 values
c0_identity.rank1_output: apply the MAP action set as one deterministic N1 batch to the exact APNCC input graph
c0_identity.missing_or_nonfinite_evidence: whole component falls back byte-semantically to APNCC
forbidden: score normalization selected from held outcomes

c2_fixed_rule.fallback: whole component to APNCC if fewer than eight feasible assignments, any constrained solve is infeasible, or any proposed edit fails the membership/min-marginal conjunction

literature.transfer: ranked assignment enumeration, not evidence of G-02 gain
K-best partitioning, not a cell-tracking cost model
